title: Loyalty pilot sync: points logic, notifications, staging
summary: Layla and Omar planned the loyalty-points pilot for a client that wants a demo before the end of the month. Points expire after six months and expiry runs as a daily batch job. The pilot uses push notifications only; SMS is parked until a budget exists. Which two branches run the pilot is still open.

decisions.text: Point expiry runs as a daily batch (cron) job, not in real time.
The pilot uses push notifications only; SMS/OTP is parked until budget is approved.
The pilot runs in two client branches.

action_items.text: First draft of the POS integration API docs
Natural (not literal) Arabic copy for push notifications, then send to Rana for the mockups
Deploy the points service to staging
Ask the client which two branches run the pilot
Log the open questions in the ticket

open_questions.text: Which two branches will run the pilot?
Is there budget for SMS (OTP) after the pilot?

companies.name: the client (unnamed)
companies.context: Retail client with branches and a POS; wants a demo before end of month.

language_notes: Layla speaks Levantine Arabic (بدنا، رح، هلأ، كتير); Omar speaks Gulf Arabic (وايد، أبي، زين، نسويه).
Technical terms stay in English inside Arabic sentences (cron, real-time, staging, API, POS), usually with the الـ prefix.
Omar's Thursday deadline comes with إن شاء الله; treat it as a soft commitment for a first draft.
One short "Okay." at 01:30 could not be attributed to a speaker (UNKNOWN).
